tree.heading: Requirement to maintain records
tree.text: The President shall maintain detailed records on the use of any aircraft made available to a foreign country under this part, including aircraft made available before October 27, 1986.

tree.heading: Congressional access to records
tree.text: The President shall make the records maintained pursuant to subsection (a) available to the Congress upon a request of the Chairman of the Committee on Foreign Affairs of the House of Representatives or the Chairman of the Committee on Foreign Relations of the Senate.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1992—Pub. L. 102–583 substituted “President” for “Secretary of State” in subsecs. (a) and (b).

notes.heading: Delegation of Functions
notes.text: For delegation of functions of President under this section, see Ex. Ord. No. 12163, Sept. 29, 1979, 44 F.R. 56673, as amended, set out as a note under section 2381 of this title.
